cohort: 714 women with singleton pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia at Fujian Maternity and Child Health Hospital, categorized based on the presence of fetal growth restriction (FGR).
finding: A predictive nomogram, incorporating nine significant predictors (family history of hypertension, AST, URIC, mode of delivery, MPV, PT, severity of preeclampsia, post-pregnancy weight, and gestational age), was developed and validated as a reliable tool for predicting fetal growth restriction in pregnant individuals with preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as one of nine significant predictors for fetal growth restriction in preeclampsia patients.
